# 河图洛书 Hetu Luoshu

> Local IP creative workspace for authors and studios. Chinese first, English supported. Version 0.2.0. macOS source implementation; Windows follows separate implementation and verification.

Hetu Luoshu organizes a multi-book author library with independent covers, chapters, story bibles, plot, drama outlines, reference review, excerpt adoption, separate finalization and local Git snapshots. Format conversion and complete delivery bundles require release-specific verification. The core contains no models or generation APIs. External agents connect through local MCP; authors retain approval authority. Rule checks expose evidence, coverage and uncertainty.

- [中文首页](https://hetu.limeai.run/)
- [English](https://hetu.limeai.run/en/)
- [Documentation](https://hetu.limeai.run/en/docs/): Practical user guides in Simplified Chinese and English.
- [Workflow](https://hetu.limeai.run/en/workflow/)
- [Integrations](https://hetu.limeai.run/en/integrations/)
- [FAQ](https://hetu.limeai.run/en/faq/)
- [Source](https://github.com/limecloud/hetu): Apache-2.0 core.

Images depict product design; mobile visuals are extensions, not released mobile apps. The interactive prototype is embedded at /#prototype and /en/#prototype, uses demo data, resets on refresh, and does not access a real workspace. There are no standalone prototype pages.
